messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance - Sunday 16 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 on Sunday 16 March until 02:00 Monday for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any open documents beforehand. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
